step1_analysis.description: A single-pole double-throw switch used to connect an antenna to either a transmitter or a receiver. It uses DC biasing on the source/drain nodes to reduce junction capacitance and improve power handling.

paper_reference.title: A 0.5-m CMOS T/R Switch for 900-MHz Wireless Applications

Insertion_Loss_dB.description: S21 transmission from TX to ANT in TX mode at 900 MHz

sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist uses default W=5um which is much smaller than typical mm-sized switch transistors, resulting in high Ron and high insertion loss.

Isolation_dB.description: S31 leakage from TX to RX in TX mode at 900 MHz

sky130_expected.calculation: Coupling through XM2 Cgs (~6fF). Zc = 1/(2*pi*900M*6fF) = 29kOhm. Attenuation = 50/29k = 0.0017 (-55dB). Total S31 = -19dB - 55dB = -74dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Isolation is dominated by the parasitic capacitance of the OFF transistor XM2.

Transient_Swing_ANT.description: Peak-to-peak voltage swing at the antenna for a 10dBm (2V peak open-circuit) input at 900 MHz

sky130_expected.reasoning: Due to the high insertion loss from the small W=5um transistor, the output swing is heavily attenuated.

DC_Power.description: DC power consumption of the switch biasing circuit

sky130_expected.calculation: Leakage currents only, expected to be in the pW to nW range.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The switch is passive and only draws leakage current from the DC bias sources.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure insertion loss, isolation, transient swing, and DC power of the T/R switch in TX mode.
step3_testbench.spice:
* T/R Switch Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 ANT LABEL_NET_0 TX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 LABEL_NET_1 ANT RX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 TX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS LABEL_NET_2 TX_SOURCE_DC_BIAS GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

* DC Biasing (0.9V to reduce junction capacitance as per paper)
Vdc dc_bias 0 0.9
Rdc_tx TX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS dc_bias 10k
Rdc_ant ANT dc_bias 10k
Rdc_rx RX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS dc_bias 10k
Rdc_tx_src TX_SOURCE_DC_BIAS dc_bias 10k

* Control Voltages (TX Mode: XM1 ON, XM2 OFF, XM3 OFF)
* Note: LABEL_NET_1 is set to 0.9V to prevent XM2 from turning on due to swapped D/G in extraction
Vctrl0 LABEL_NET_0 0 1.8
Vctrl1 LABEL_NET_1 0 0.9
Vctrl2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9

* RF Ports (50 ohm system)
Vac tx_ac 0 dc 0 ac 2 sin(0 2 900Meg)
Rin tx_ac TX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS 50

Cout ANT ant_ac 1u
Rout ant_ac 0 50

Crx RX_AND_DRAIN_DC_BIAS rx_ac 1u
Rrx rx_ac 0 50

.control
* 1. DC Operating Point
op
let dc_power = -i(Vdc) * 0.9
print dc_power

* 2. AC Analysis for Insertion Loss and Isolation
ac dec 100 100Meg 10Gig
let s21_db = vdb(ant_ac)
let s31_db = vdb(rx_ac)
meas ac insertion_loss_db find s21_db at=900Meg
meas ac isolation_db find s31_db at=900Meg
print insertion_loss_db isolation_db

* 3. Transient Analysis for Voltage Swing
tran 10p 5n
meas tran v_max max v(ant_ac)
meas tran v_min min v(ant_ac)
let transient_swing_ant = v_max - v_min
print transient_swing_ant

quit
.endc
.end
